tasks.short: Participate in campus and community events

steps.what: Clarify the actual campus or community event's audience, purpose, place, timing and the criminal justice teacher's contribution with its organiser.
Write the short participation confirmation in {EMAIL} and check the completed text, recipient, contribution and date against the understood commitment.
Send the checked participation confirmation to the organiser through {EMAIL}.
Participate in campus and community events, discuss criminal justice teaching and research appropriately with the actual audience, respond to questions and carry out the agreed contribution.

tasks.design: Retain direct participation and its short existing {EMAIL} confirmation. Test native reply and calendar facilities first; no repeated entry or substantial drafting burden is established here.
tasks.previous_blocker: The work depends on a real audience and the teacher's response to it.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing communication tools already support the limited coordination.
tasks.still_hard: Handling sensitive questions about justice without presenting unsupported conclusions.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher provides an accountable public contribution and listens to the audience.
tasks.altitude: The teacher's event responsibilities and week remain unchanged.

reach.learn: Adapt explanations to community concerns and confidentiality boundaries.

evidence.claim: A short event reply and direct participation do not by themselves establish an automation saving.

assumptions: Boundary: an invited teacher's participation, not organising the entire event or publishing a research paper. No routine post-event report is required by this task.
The organiser supplies audience, purpose, date, location, requested contribution and contact; the teacher clarifies missing fields directly in s1. No prepared structured event feed is assumed.
The ordinary completed-message check in s2 gates s3; editing the message or recipient voids that check. This adds no approval meeting.
All shares are illustrative E1 workflow estimates, not measured baselines. Zero incremental upkeep is justified because no new software or workflow is introduced.
unknowns: Whether this institution separately requires an event report or reimbursement claim.
research_questions: Is any actual event paperwork repeated enough to warrant a separate measured workflow?

already_counted.description: Clarification, actual confirmation and participation remain in full.

approvals.approved_version: Exact confirmation text, recipient and event date checked in s2

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The confirmation and event interaction are already short or intrinsically personal; no repeated transaction is established to remove.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Conduct criminal justice research and publish findings

steps.what: Find and verify original criminal justice research literature using the scholarly catalogue and reference manager in {OTHER}; native saved searches reduce repeated navigation while full source assessment remains.
Design and conduct research in the particular criminal justice field, secure applicable research permissions, collect actual evidence and check sampling, provenance, coding and confidentiality.
outputs: verified research data and method record

steps.what: Calculate the specified descriptive tables and checks in the statistical analysis software {OTHER}; configure repeatable analysis commands for the teacher's validated variables, retaining data inspection and exception repair.
inputs: verified research data and method record

steps.what: Interpret the actual analysis, assess alternative explanations, bias and limitations, and determine which criminal justice findings the evidence supports.
inputs: verified research data and method record

steps.what: Write and substantively revise the research manuscript in {DOCS}, checking every argument, quotation, table, limitation and disclosure against the actual research and permitted publication scope.
inputs: verified research data and method record

steps.what: Apply the journal or book publisher's required citation and manuscript format using native reference-manager and document-style functions in {OTHER} and {DOCS}, checking unresolved citations and formatting exceptions.

Check the completed manuscript version, author permissions, identifying information, required disclosures and exact submission destination against the completed substantive review and publisher requirements.
Save the checked final manuscript version in {DOCS}.
Submit the exact checked manuscript and required disclosures to publish findings in professional journals, books or electronic media through the publisher's submission system {OTHER}.

tasks.design: Configure native scholarly search, statistical analysis and reference formatting before considering custom code. Keep evidence collection, interpretation and substantive writing with the researcher, then save and submit the exact checked manuscript as separate actions.
tasks.previous_blocker: Research data, analytical judgement and publication requirements are different kinds of work.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing scholarly, statistical and document tools can repeat validated searches, calculations and styles.
tasks.still_hard: Distinguishing robust findings from biased samples or unsupported causal claims.
tasks.human_edge: The researcher owns the question, method, interpretation and public claims.

ambition.what: Check one additional researcher-chosen sensitivity specification before finalising a quantitative manuscript, using the configured analysis.

tasks.altitude: Less repeated tool operation leaves time for methodological criticism; publication authority does not expand.

reach.learn: Assess sampling bias and justified inference in observational studies.

evidence.claim: Native scholarly searches, statistical commands and reference styles can repeat specified operations without deciding research meaning.

assumptions: Boundary: the teacher's complete research-to-submission cycle for a quantitative criminal justice paper, including actual evidence collection, revisions and substantive checks. Publisher production and other authors' labour earn no saving.

The researcher produces variable definitions, units, missing-value rules, sample exclusions and approved analysis definitions in s2; actual source documents and permitted data are inspected there. Unstructured records are manually coded and checked in that retained step, not supplied as a free dataset.

Scholarly sources supply titles, authors, dates and identifiers; the teacher verifies them in s1 and repairs missing metadata during s6. Publisher requirements are read from the actual venue, not inferred.

The final routine package check in s7 follows the complete manuscript; it binds each requested save/submit gate without extra approval labour. Any manuscript, permission or destination change invalidates both gates.

Shares and reductions are E1 scenarios, not measured institutional baselines. No model writes findings, no machine-runtime saving is claimed, and qualitative studies require a different analysis estimate.
unknowns: Current reference styles and analysis commands already configured
Actual data access, publication permissions and coauthor review requirements
research_questions: How much active time is repeated calculation or formatting, rather than evidence interpretation?

already_counted.description: Actual research, source checks, analysis exceptions, manuscript writing and publication actions remain counted.

incremental.description: Maintain search definitions, analysis reproducibility and reference-style exceptions.

approvals.approved_version: Exact final manuscript and storage version checked in s7
Exact manuscript, disclosures and publisher destination checked in s7

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 12 less 2 upkeep gives net 10 when searches, specified calculations and formatting are repeatedly manual. An already-configured or predominantly qualitative study can yield no net saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Supervise student teaching, internship and research work

steps.what: Find the student's actual teaching, internship or research submissions, placement objectives and prior agreed actions in {LMS}; native links and assignment views reduce repeated navigation while full contextual reading remains.

Supervise undergraduate or graduate teaching, internship and research work by observing actual progress, discussing judgement and ethical problems, challenging weak evidence and agreeing appropriate next work with the student.
outputs: actual supervision findings and agreed actions

steps.what: Write the actual supervision findings, action owner and due point in the restricted {LMS} supervision record and check the completed note's meaning, student identity and access scope.
inputs: actual supervision findings and agreed actions
actual student identity and record access

steps.what: Save the exact checked supervision note to the student's restricted {LMS} record.

tasks.design: Configure the existing {LMS} supervision view to open current student evidence and objectives together. Preserve actual supervision and writing its factual note; a same-system save retains its full time.
tasks.previous_blocker: The teacher must connect work evidence with the student's actual circumstances.
tasks.enabler_now: Native assignment links and supervision views can reduce finding the right material.
tasks.still_hard: Assessing readiness and ethical judgement in justice-related placements.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher challenges reasoning and responds to the student in context.

ambition.what: No new supervision service is assumed.

tasks.altitude: Preparation becomes shorter; supervision responsibility and student decisions remain unchanged.

reach.learn: Separate evidence of competence from incomplete placement reports.

evidence.claim: Native learning-system views can link submissions and objectives without replacing supervision judgement.

assumptions: Boundary: preparation, actual supervision and its existing internal note; formal final grading, disciplinary decisions and separate placement-provider transactions are distinct tasks and earn no saving here.

Student and placement inputs contain student identity, submission version, objective, actual progress and prior actions. Their real producers supply them; missing or inconsistent evidence is sought directly and read in s1-s2, not model-inferred.

The teacher creates the note from actual supervision in s3. Its ordinary completed-note check supplies the requested save gate; edits or changed record access void it without adding an approval stage.
Shares are illustrative E1 estimates. There is no automatic completed-placement inference from a timetable or student attendance.
unknowns: Actual current supervision-record features and permitted visibility
research_questions: Does navigation rather than reading consume the claimed preparation time?

already_counted.description: Evidence verification, supervision, actual note composition and save remain counted.

incremental.description: Maintain supervision links and access after cohort changes.

approvals.approved_version: Exact note, student record and access checked in s3

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 8 less 1 upkeep gives net 7 where native views remove repeated navigation. Existing well-linked records offer no net improvement.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Receive and clarify actual department-head administrative issues about teaching cover, research activity, students and departmental resources, identifying the teacher's remit and which decisions require another institutional authority.

Locate and verify current workload, course and resource records in {LMS} and {DOCS}; native saved views reduce repeated navigation and retain resolving missing or stale facts with their actual owners.

Perform administrative duties as department head by discussing departmental needs, resolving conflicts, weighing workload and resource choices, and making or escalating decisions within the actual delegation.

Write the departmental decision report or instruction in {DOCS}; native templates reuse verified course and issue identifiers while the teacher writes and checks the actual reasons, action owners, dates, authority limits and recipient list in the completed version.
Save the checked departmental instruction in its restricted {DOCS} record.
Send the exact checked departmental instruction to the identified action owners through {EMAIL}.

tasks.design: Configure native {LMS} and {DOCS} views and document fields before adding code. Keep issue clarification and departmental decisions human; only repeated source navigation and factual report fields lose time, with each final save and send separate.
tasks.previous_blocker: Department decisions span records, colleague needs and institutional authority.
tasks.enabler_now: Native views and templates can reuse controlled facts without making those decisions.
tasks.still_hard: Resolving competing teaching and research commitments fairly.
tasks.human_edge: The department head explains choices and remains accountable to colleagues.

ambition.what: No expanded authority or departmental service is claimed.

tasks.altitude: Less factual preparation leaves more attention for unresolved departmental issues; delegation limits stay unchanged.

reach.learn: Assess resource conflicts against actual curriculum requirements.

evidence.claim: Existing document templates and learning-system views can reuse controlled departmental facts while leaving decisions human.

assumptions: Boundary: the teacher's administrative issue-to-decision-report work as department head. Teaching cover, research and resource deliberations are included; any distinct hiring contract, payroll change or payment has its own authorised workflow and receives no saving here.

Course administrators produce course identifiers, teaching allocations and current versions; resource owners supply actual availability and limits. The teacher verifies provenance and resolves missing data in s2. No free cross-system export or new extraction service is assumed.

The teacher produces actual decisions in s3 and the final instruction in s4. Native templates only reuse verified fields; rationale and instructions are authored and checked, not generated from policy guesses.
The normal completed-instruction check in s4 binds each requested save/send gate without added approval labour. Changed contents, authority or recipients invalidate both gates.
Shares and cuts are illustrative E1 estimates, not an invented measured baseline. Test current native facilities first; consultation and access effort depend on institutional and national rules.
unknowns: Which departmental records are already linked
research_questions: Which report fields are genuinely re-entered instead of already populated?

already_counted.description: Clarification, source verification, deliberation, substantive report writing and final actions remain counted.

incremental.description: Maintain factual template fields, source links and record access.

approvals.approved_version: Exact departmental instruction and restricted destination checked in s4
Exact departmental instruction and action-owner recipients checked in s4

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 8.6 less 1 upkeep gives net 7.6 when navigation and factual fields repeat manually. Already-populated reports or predominantly contentious decisions can produce zero net gain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Research and administrative preparation become more repeatable; teaching, supervision and public accountability remain with the teacher.
reach: Learn social-research sensitivity analysis and course-resource coordination.
skills_to_grow: Departmental delegation and sensitive record handling
role.ambitious_version: Use reproducible preparation to test a research sensitivity and address departmental conflicts with better evidence.
